posts.name: Ridge line carousel
posts.why: It showed the new aid station and the finish arch, the two things runners ask about most in the comments.
posts.how: One carousel per race distance in November, each with its own route photos.

posts.name: Route markers carousel
posts.why: Saves were high, so people kept it to read again before race day.
posts.how: A second checklist post for the night before the race.

posts.name: Forest single track Reel
posts.why: Movement from the first second and a clear trail hook.
posts.how: Two new trail Reels in November from fresh route footage.

content-insights.takeaway: Route and scenery posts led on reach and engagement, and Reels beat every other format.
content-insights.doMore: Route and scenery as Reels. Best pillar, best format.
content-insights.keep: Countdown posts. Steady reach and they carry the entry message.
content-insights.rework: Training tips as short Reels. Static tips reach the fewest people.

competitors.takeaway: We have {ig.followers} Instagram followers, and grew faster than two of the three accounts we track.

looking-ahead.takeaway: November is the last full month of entries: the push is to turn interest into sign-ups.

blocks.heading: Content
